<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

The hippocampus makes a tail Strike, then [Swims](/Actions.aspx?ID=2381) with a +10- foot circumstance bonus to its swim Speed. The hippocampus and its rider gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement.
